This editorial illustration features a man from the chest up, set against a solid black background. He has dark hair, a light complexion, and wears a white collared shirt. He is looking towards the right and holding up a small object with his left hand.

The object is a white, rounded, ceramic-like container shaped like a cow with black spots. It has a small pink nose and four tiny pink dots for eyes and nostrils. A thin coin slot is visible on its upper back. The man's hand supports the cow from beneath.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, red, bold capital letters across the upper third of the image. Above this, white text reads: "SETELAH RISMA BERBAJU MERAH" and "MANUVER BANK SENTRAL MEMBONSAI OJK". Below the main title, white text reads: "3-9 AGUSTUS 2015" and "BANSOS DAHULU SUAP KEMUDIAN". In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode and smaller text: "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN 0126-4273", and "00023". A solid red vertical border runs along the far left edge.
